name: AR-Bench
description: AR-Bench is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' active reasoning skills, requiring models to interact with external systems to acquire missing information. It includes three task families—detective cases, situation puzzles, and guessing numbers—that simulate real-world agentic scenarios and test commonsense, logical, and symbolic reasoning.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark with limited adoption, mainly of interest for evaluating active reasoning and tool-using agent behavior.
notes: Focuses on active reasoning where models must acquire missing information; publicly available.
